dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Wow, you found me so fast! You must play this game a LOT.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, d'you think you'll find them all?

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Aah! You found me! A—Are you a magician?

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: You made me happy today! Almost as happy as when Mommy and Daddy come home! Let's play it again soooon!
